PU-2101B.title: Feed Charge Pump PU-2101B Mechanical Seal Leakage
PU-2101B.problem_statement: Mechanical seal of Feed Charge Pump PU-2101B failed on 12-Mar-2026, causing seal leakage and an unplanned feed reduction to the ARP reactor section.
PU-2101B.root_cause: Premature mechanical seal failure caused by intermittent dry-running: suction cavitation during feed swings reduced NPSH and seal-flush flow dropped below the 6 L/min minimum, with no interlock to protect the seal.
chronology: 11-Mar-2026: Field operator noted minor seal weep on PU-2101B during routine round.
12-Mar-2026 02:15: Seal flush low-flow alarm annunciated; visible feed seal leak with low suction pressure. Pump auto-tripped on low discharge pressure.
12-Mar-2026 09:20: Seal cartridge & shaft sleeve inspected; seal faces heat-checked / worn (dry-running signature).
12-Mar-2026 20:45: New seal cartridge installed, pump commissioned, feed restored to ~13.6 T/H.

corrective_actions.action: Install seal-flush flow switch with DCS alarm on PU-2101B
Add low-NPSH / loss-of-flush trip interlock in DCS
Revise feed-swing SOP to cap ramp at 1 T/H per minute
Add seal-flush system (Plan 11) to PU-2101B PM check-sheet

KO-3201.title: Cracked Gas Compressor KO-3201 High Radial Vibration Trip
KO-3201.problem_statement: Cracked Gas Compressor KO-3201 tripped on high-high radial vibration on 29-Apr-2026 due to journal-bearing babbitt distress driven by water-contaminated lube oil.
KO-3201.root_cause: Journal-bearing babbitt distress caused by degraded oil-film strength from water ingress via a leaking lube-oil cooler tube, undetected due to absence of online water-in-oil monitoring, leading to rising vibration and a high-high trip.
chronology: 27-Apr-2026: ZCU compression train running normal; KO-3201 drive-end (DE) radial vibration trending up (from 28 to 52 micron over 5 days).
29-Apr-2026 06:40: KO-3201 DE vibration reached high-high setpoint (75 micron); machinery protection system tripped the compressor.
29-Apr-2026 08:10: Lube-oil sample taken water content 1,800 ppm (spec < 500 ppm).
30-Apr-2026 14:40: New bearing installed, lube-oil system flushed, cooler tube plugged, train restarted.

corrective_actions.action: Repair leaking lube-oil cooler tube (plug + re-test)
Install online water-in-oil sensor on KO-3201 lube system
Tighten KO-3201 vibration alert to 45 micron & shorten trend-review cadence
Add lube-oil cooler dP & conductivity trend to reliability dashboard

PM-4405B.title: Cooling Water Pump PM-4405B Motor Bearing Failure
PM-4405B.problem_statement: Cooling Water Pump PM-4405B motor tripped on 08-Jul-2026 due to drive-end bearing failure from grease degradation and an over-extended re-lubrication interval.
PM-4405B.root_cause: Motor drive-end bearing failure caused by grease degradation from an over-extended, non-risk-based re-lubrication interval, undetected due to absence of bearing-temperature trending, resulting in bearing overheating and motor trip.
chronology: 06-Jul-2026: Motor DE bearing temperature trending up (68 to 84 °C).
08-Jul-2026 13:20: Motor bearing high-temperature alarm; motor tripped on winding/bearing over-temp.
08-Jul-2026 16:00: Motor DE bearing found seized; grease degraded/carbonized.
08-Jul-2026 21:20: DE & NDE bearings replaced and re-greased; motor recommissioned.

corrective_actions.action: Revise PM-4405B re-lubrication interval to risk-based (4-monthly)
Add motor bearing temperature trending & alert to CMMS
Add PM-4405B/C to monthly vibration & thermography route

HE-3301.title: Feed/Effluent Heat Exchanger HE-3301 High Fouling
HE-3301.problem_statement: Feed/Effluent Heat Exchanger HE-3301 suffered accelerated tube-side fouling reducing duty and raising dP, forcing an unplanned isolation, cleaning and partial rate cut.
HE-3301.root_cause: Accelerated tube-side coke/polymer fouling driven by higher-than-design feed heavy-ends, allowed to progress by the absence of a dP-based cleaning trigger and fouling KPI, causing duty loss, high dP and a forced rate cut.
chronology: 18-May-2026: HE-3301 tube-side dP rising (0.4 to 0.9 bar) and cold-outlet temperature falling.
21-May-2026 09:00: Preheat duty dropped ~35% below design; unit rate reduced. Exchanger isolated.
21-May-2026 11:30: Tube bundle inspected - heavy coke/polymer deposition on tube side.
21-May-2026 21:00: Bundle hydro-jet cleaned and returned to service; rate ramped back to 30 T/H.

corrective_actions.action: Add dP-based cleaning trigger & alarm for HE-3301
Add fouling factor & duty KPI to reliability dashboard

BL-5702.title: Product Blower BL-5702 High Vibration (Coupling Misalignment)
BL-5702.problem_statement: Product Blower BL-5702 tripped on high vibration on 17-Jun-2026 due to coupling misalignment and a worn coupling element, halting the OPP powder-handling section.
BL-5702.root_cause: High vibration from coupling misalignment aggravated by soft-foot and an over-aged elastomer coupling element, undetected because periodic alignment/soft-foot checks were absent from the PM and the vibration route interval was too long.
chronology: 15-Jun-2026: BL-5702 vibration trending up (4.2 to 8.5 mm/s) with 2X harmonic rising.
17-Jun-2026 04:30: Vibration reached alarm (11 mm/s); blower stopped to prevent damage.
17-Jun-2026 07:00: Coupling element found worn/cracked; laser alignment showed 0.35 mm offset (spec < 0.05 mm).
17-Jun-2026 18:30: Element replaced, re-aligned to < 0.05 mm, blower restarted to 38 T/H.

corrective_actions.action: Add periodic laser alignment & soft-foot check to BL-5702 PM
Track coupling element life & replace at 12 months
Shorten BL-5702 vibration route to weekly
